recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-20471; any future publication or maintenance work for these contexts belongs with the Extension Pack artifact and FHIR-56196.
issue_request: FHIR-20471 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to extend the capabilitystatement-expectation extension so it could be used on SearchParameter.multipleOr, SearchParameter.multipleAnd, SearchParameter.comparator, SearchParameter.modifier, and SearchParameter.chain rather than changing those SearchParameter elements into complex structures.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #1964 applied the issue in commit dfa5fb0aaf706c9e4d8c420446baf5e99573c347 by adding SearchParameter contexts to source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-extension-capabilitystatement-expectation.xml, though the first patch misspelled SearchParameter.modifier as SearchParameter.modifer. Later extension-context cleanup removed those contexts, and dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed core extension definitions from the R5 source tree.
additional_context: SearchParameter remains active in current core and still defines the requested elements. Core no longer owns a capabilitystatement-expectation StructureDefinition source file; extension links use the extensions-location mechanism. FHIR-56196 later approved the same SearchParameter contexts in the Extension Pack, and fhir-extensions commit 8f34290b8972a617f952062bcfde80de2e652014 added them with the correct SearchParameter.modifier spelling.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Re-adding a core extension definition or redundant core prose would be out of build scope and could diverge from the Extension Pack source of truth.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-20471 was filed as a follow-up mechanism for the SearchParameter declaration problem raised in FHIR-20470.
This FHIR-extensions issue restored the same capabilitystatement-expectation contexts for SearchParameter after extension definitions moved out of core.

evidence_items.summary: PR #1964 initially applied FHIR-20471 by adding SearchParameter contexts to the core capabilitystatement-expectation extension source.

evidence_items.learned: The owning extension source already satisfies FHIR-20471, including the correct SearchParameter.modifier spelling.
